name: nexus-mcp
description: Your coding agent reads less code to find the right file. Local code search and call graph. No API keys, no telemetry.
long_description: Nexus-MCP indexes your code on your machine and gives the agent hybrid search, a static call graph and the code of any symbol in one call, so it reads less code: 95% fewer tokens to reach the right file (median of 10 open-source repos). It needs uv. The first start downloads the Python packages and the embedding model, so it takes a few minutes. Free and open source under the MIT licence.

tools.name: index
tools.description: Build or refresh the code index of a project.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find code by meaning or by keyword.

tools.name: find_symbol
tools.description: Get the code of functions and classes by name, with callers and callees.

tools.name: graph
tools.description: Show who calls a symbol and what breaks if it changes.

tools.name: map
tools.description: Give an overview of the project layout.
